div.head: Grið 18
div.ab: ⁊ gyf he þyssa ænig aleoge, nahwar he eft his feorh gefare ne geyrne.
And gyf he þyssa ænig aleoge, nahwar he eft his feorh gefare ne geyrne.
Und wenn er eines dieser [Versprechen] bricht, erlange oder errenne er nirgends wieder sein Leben.
And if he breaks any of these [promises], let him nowhere again obtain or run to safety with his life.
And if he breaks any of these oaths, he may not go anywhere in his life or take flight.

note.label: mitigates
note.quote: This clause mitigates the more severe punishment of execution decreed in 6 Æthelstan 12.2 for those guilty of second offenses.
